subject: Roshan rig pilot: the rig drives the LTX guides
question: Which deterministic-rig pilot to build, given the 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-07 whole-frame, whole-sprite and constant-size rules?
decision: Chose "Rig drives the guides": track the LTX take, solve it onto a fixed-length rig, and use the rig's poses as proportion-locked guides for the next whole-frame LTX take.

subject: Claude may render this pilot's guides and preview
question: For this pilot, may Claude render the rig's guide images itself instead of writing them up for Codex?
decision: "Yes, render them": a one-time exception to the 2026-09-30 written-handoff rule, covering only the rig pilot's guide images and previews.

subject: Rig pilot: one rules-off test run, then rules back
question: How to trial the deterministic rig against the existing Roshan animation rules?
decision: "Trial two test runs, one that completely ignores these rules for purposes of testing, and then if there are problems or shortfalls with the drafts that are analyzed, introduce these rules back again. The game was previously incapable of animating in this way, I suspect that it may be, but permit claude to trial using a different approach." Scope: the rig pilot's run 1 only; the whole-frame, whole-sprite, no-Roshan-rig and written-handoff rules remain binding for production and run 2.

subject: Rig pilot run 1: whole-body acting, blink, hair flow, no frame artifacts
question: Review of rig pilot run 1 (rules-off Godot rig, revision 1).
decision: "This is acceptable as a rough take, but mermaid roshan is frozen otherwise. Give her a full body natural movement that accompanies the hand raise, have her blink, make her hair flow slightly in the water. It's progress" and "There are also a lot of frame-by-frame artifacts present currently". Scope: the rig pilot's run 1 (revision 2).

subject: Rig pilot run 1 revision 2 rejected
question: Review of rig pilot run 1 revision 2 (rules-off Godot rig with authored acting, idle, hair flow and blink).
decision: "No, these are failures. there are overdraw errors, the figure doesn't move as a whole, there are some rough crop issues as well. analyze potential solutions, including the old protocols". Scope: run 1 (the cut-out/skinned runtime rig) is closed as evidence; the rig is used only to author run-2 guides.

subject: Rig pilot: keep trialling methods until satisfied
question: After the method analysis, how far should the pilot go?
decision: "Continue, trial methods until satisfied". Recorded scope: local RTX 3060 Ti takes for this pilot with the owner rules back on; Claude bounds it at 8 generated takes counting failures, diagnosed between batches, no paid or API calls, no new budget, no runtime or delivery acceptance.

subject: Outfits must keep working with the animation process
question: Requirement on the animation workflow being trialled.
decision: "Also, in this process, Insure that cosmetics, like new clothes, will still work with the animation process, this is critical". Scope: any animation route chosen must carry the game outfits (ribbon, party, garden, disguise and future clothes) onto every animation frame.
